seo.title: Terms | FIT X Studio
seo.description: Website terms for FIT X Studio, Manunda, Cairns: prices, the 2-week trial, bookings and memberships.

p: These terms cover this website and buying a pass from it. They are provided by {legalName} (ABN {abn}). Memberships are covered by the membership agreement and fee schedule you sign when you join, and those documents take priority over this website.

Prices on this site are in Australian dollars and include GST. They may change; the price shown in Mindbody when you pay is the price you are charged, and the fee schedule you are given when you join applies to your membership.

2 weeks of unlimited classes for a one-off payment, bought through Mindbody. It runs for 14 days from your first visit. If you stay on as a Premium member, your trial weeks count towards your minimum term.
Book classes through Mindbody. You can cancel free of charge up to 12 hours before a class. If you miss three booked classes in 30 days without cancelling in time, a $10 fee applies from the third.

Everyone completes a pre-exercise screening before their first session. If your answers need it, we may ask for clearance from your doctor before you train. Tell your coach about any injury or health change.
FIT X Studio is for women only. You need to be 16 or over; if you are 16 or 17, a parent or guardian signs with you.
Reviews are quoted word for word from public Google and Mindbody reviews, with the reviewer's first name and last initial.
Nothing in these terms limits your rights under the Australian Consumer Law.
